mapper.insert: INSERT INTO private_message (sender_id, receiver_id, content, send_time, is_read) VALUES (#{senderId}, #{receiverId}, #{content}, #{sendTime}, #{isRead})
mapper.select: SELECT id, sender_id as senderId, receiver_id as receiverId, content, send_time as sendTime, is_read as isRead, created_at as createdAt FROM private_message WHERE receiver_id = #{receiverId} AND is_read = false ORDER BY send_time DESC

SELECT id, sender_id as senderId, receiver_id as receiverId, content, send_time as sendTime, is_read as isRead, created_at as createdAt FROM private_message WHERE (sender_id = #{senderId} AND receiver_id = #{receiverId}) OR (sender_id = #{receiverId} AND receiver_id = #{senderId}) ORDER BY send_time ASC
